items.title: Relatively very ample implies relatively ample
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a relatively very ample invertible sheaf on a quasi-compact morphism is relatively ample. The proof expands the definition of very ampleness into an immersion into a projective bundle, presents that bundle as a relative Proj of the symmetric algebra, constructs the natural map from the symmetric algebra into the graded sheaf of powers of the invertible sheaf using the identification along the immersion and adjointness, and concludes by the sixth characterisation of relative ampleness once the associated morphism is identified with the given immersion.
